title: OLX.ba Exits & Price Endings
description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event dates and reported daily prices rather than reconstructed inventory.

filters.name: category
filters.label: Category
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT property_type AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE property_type IS NOT NULL AND property_type <> 'daily_rent' ORDER BY 1

filters.name: rooms
filters.label: Rooms
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exits
panels.description: Listings that left OLX in the selected time window, compared with the window before it. An exit is not a confirmed sale.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), coverage AS (SELECT (min(started_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS start FROM lean.scrape_runs) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS exits, CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closed_at <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) END AS exits_prev, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closing_ppm2>0)::numeric,0) AS median_exit_ppm2, CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closed_at <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closing_ppm2>0)::numeric,0) END AS median_exit_ppm2_prev, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_listed) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date))::numeric,1) AS median_days_on_market, CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_listed) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closed_at <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date))::numeric,1) END AS median_days_on_market_prev, round((SELECT count(*) FROM active)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) * 30.0 / NULLIF(((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - GREATEST((${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date, (SELECT start FROM coverage))), 0), 0), 1) AS months_of_inventory FROM base

panels.title: Months of inventory

panels.title: Final asking KM/m² by exit week · sales
panels.description: Median and interquartile range of the last asking price per m² of sale listings that left OLX each week.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT date_trunc('week', closed_at::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p25,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2)::numeric,0) AS median,round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p75,count(*) AS listings FROM base WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closing_ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Final ask vs opening ask
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN b.closing_price<opening.opening_price THEN 'lower' WHEN b.closing_price>opening.opening_price THEN 'higher' ELSE 'same' END AS direction,count(*) AS listings FROM base b JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=b.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= b.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN price_date < b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1) opening ON TRUE WHERE (b.closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND b.closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND b.closing_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) d ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['lower','same','higher'], direction)

panels.title: Exit share by KM/m² band · sales
panels.description: Exits in the selected time window as a share of exits plus current actives, by asking KM/m².
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT CASE WHEN bracket < 2000 THEN 'under 2k' WHEN bracket >= 6000 THEN '6k+' ELSE (bracket/1000)||'–'||(bracket/1000+1)||'k' END AS ppm2_band,round(100.0*sum(exits)/NULLIF(sum(exits)+sum(actives),0),1) AS exit_ratio,sum(exits) AS exits,sum(actives) AS active FROM (SELECT (floor(closing_ppm2/1000)*1000)::int AS bracket,count(*) AS exits,0::bigint AS actives FROM base WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND closing_ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT (floor(ppm2/1000)*1000)::int,0,count(*) FROM active WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(bracket)

panels.title: Days listed vs final price change
panels.description: Change from the cycle's opening ask to its final ask. Changes beyond −50% / +100% are left out as likely data errors. Click a dot to open the ad.

(${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT b.days_listed::float8 AS days_listed, (100.0*(b.closing_price/opening.opening_price-1))::float8 AS final_change_pct,b.title,b.url,b.article_id FROM base b JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=b.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= b.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND b.closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND b.closing_price IS NOT NULL AND b.closing_price BETWEEN 0.5*opening.opening_price AND 2*opening.opening_price

panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT neighborhood,sum(exits) AS exits,sum(actives) AS active,round(100.0*sum(exits)/NULLIF(sum(exits)+sum(actives),0),1) AS exit_ratio FROM (SELECT neighborhood,count(*) AS exits,0::bigint AS actives FROM base WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND neighborhood IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT neighborhood,0,count(*) FROM active WHERE neighborhood IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Recent exits
panels.description: Exits in the selected time window, newest first, with the change from the opening ask.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT r.title,r.url,r.neighborhood,r.rooms,r.sqm,opening.opening_price,r.closing_price AS final_asking_price,round(100.0*(r.closing_price/opening.opening_price-1),1) AS final_change_pct,round(r.closing_ppm2) AS closing_ppm2,r.cycle_opened_at,r.closed_at,r.days_listed FROM (SELECT * FROM base WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) ORDER BY closed_at DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 50) r LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=r.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= r.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= r.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= r.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN price_date < r.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1) opening ON TRUE ORDER BY r.closed_at DESC,r.event_id DESC

panels.title: Exit share by neighborhood and rooms
panels.description: Exits in the selected time window as a share of exits plus current actives, for the 10 neighborhoods with the most listings. Cells with fewer than 5 listings stay blank. Click a cell to filter by its neighborhood.

closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), population AS (SELECT neighborhood,coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS rooms,1 AS exited FROM base WHERE (closed_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND closed_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND neighborhood IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT neighborhood,coalesce(rooms,'unknown'),0 FROM active WHERE neighborhood IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT neighborhood,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, neighborhood) AS rank FROM population GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 10) SELECT p.neighborhood,p.rooms,sum(p.exited) AS exits,count(*)-sum(p.exited) AS active,round(100.0*sum(p.exited)/count(*),1) AS exit_ratio FROM population p JOIN ranked r USING (neighborhood) GROUP BY 1,2,r.rank HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY r.rank, 2
